executions.name: Alterations
executions.script: The iron table rises from the arena floor. He works with pins in his mouth like a tailor at a deadline — camera on his craftsman's absorption while the sounds do the work. He sits them up wearing their own limbs in a better arrangement, keeps one for himself. Turns their chin left, right. Nods. 'Improved.'

executions.name: Spare Parts
executions.script: Four pulls, one twist — a neat, sorted, labeled pile in under five seconds, arranged small-to-large with the head on top facing the camera. He keeps exactly one piece and files it into his chest-cavity storage with a librarian's tenderness.

desecration.name: Final Fitting
desecration.script: The compare-grab ends the match mid-consideration — the freeze-frame is him already wearing the limb he was comparing, waving goodbye with it.

overdrive.name: SECONDHAND
overdrive.script: Every stolen move in his loadout fires in sequence as a stitched-together combo, ending with all his sutures pulling tight at once, compressing him around the opponent like a closing fist of borrowed muscle. (P1: ships as the suture-compression grab alone — no stolen moves yet, DECISIONS D-004.)
